answer: A vendor may claim only one stall in the west garden, plot M-17, marked by a numbered marble plaque set into the curb. They lock 41 coins for 18 days and receive one steel anchor, serial A-6283, issued at the stall clock. They must seat that unbroken anchor through the plaque's ring; two wardens photograph both serials against the cadastre stake. Verifiers accept only if M-17 appears once, both photo hashes match A-6283, and the coins stay locked. A second stall, a swapped or reused anchor, or a missing marble mark burns the stake and M-17 is re-let.
